criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 3 September 2028 (24 months after the 3 September 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($1,000,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.

Identifies that the Saltash Marine Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the long-stop date as 4 December 2026 (150 days after signing on 7 July 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 18 December 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (24 months) and as a date (3 September 2028), with days remaining from 6 August 2026 (759 days).
Notes that 3 September 2028 is a Sunday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 4 September 2028.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
